title: 阿卡丽·萌趣绘本
description: 高束深色马尾，绿色蒙面布与绿紫服饰形成利落的色彩层次。

art_direction.medium: cute matte-gouache picture-book mini-character, rounded painted shapes, soft colored-ink edges, visible brush pigment and warm paper
art_direction.identity: Akali is an adult Ionian ninja with a high dark ponytail, focused eyes, a green cloth face covering, and recognizable green-purple costume accents. Preserve her lean athletic adult proportions while fully covering her torso with a fitted long-sleeved ninja jacket, opaque trousers, wraps, gloves, and boots. Her curved kama hangs motionless beside the leg, and her kunai remains securely sheathed.
art_direction.scene: A complete figure gently adjusts one existing cuff, glove, hat or scarf with a free hand; otherwise use a small curious head turn. Slightly asymmetric relaxed shoulders, a welcoming silhouette and one pale environment accent.
art_direction.palette: jade, plum shadow, pale limestone, warm gold light; preserve canonical signature hues and skin/species colors. Supporting washes: raspberry rose, pale peach and cream, with cornflower blue. Light colored shadows and matte painted highlights.
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
art_direction.tone: cute and welcoming while preserving canonical age and species

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
